item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. It's simple: the right dose, at the right time, every time. Consistency matters more than intention. If you rely on memory, you'll eventually miss one. So tie it to something you already do without thinking, like your morning routine or your evening wind-down. Notice how you feel afterward, and keep track of it. Your next step: choose one anchor habit today, and take your medication right then.
